metadata.freetext_desc: Camera-free SO-100-DUPE: six SG90 arm axes and a separate gripper via PCA9685. Executes fixed local palette targets with slew and timed settling. No position or grip feedback. Hardware must be armed locally; network commands cannot arm it.

get_state.freetext_desc: Read readiness, simulation/hardware mode, palette fingerprint and commanded-angle estimates. These are not measured positions.

begin_run.freetext_desc: Reserve an already locally armed arm for a unique run. Reject mismatched palette fingerprints or hardware mode. Starts a heartbeat lease; never arms physical hardware.

pick_place.freetext_desc: Execute exactly one fixed-slot pick/place/home cycle within the active run. Unit numbers start at 1 and increase without gaps. Component must map to this slot locally. Done means commands and settling finished, NOT verified delivery.

heartbeat.freetext_desc: Renew the active run's safety lease and return state. Must continue during movement. Expiry cancels motion and disables PWM.

end_run.freetext_desc: Finish the matching run: home, disable PWM, close driver. Physical hardware requires local re-arming before another run.

abort_run.freetext_desc: Urgently cancel only the matching run and disable PWM without recovery motion. Does not affect another run. Physical outcome is unverified.
